g.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; opacity: 1; font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; dominant-baseline: auto;

path.style: fill: rgb(255, 171, 25); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: rgb(207, 139, 23); stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; opacity: 1; display: inline; font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; dominant-baseline: auto;

text.style: fill: rgb(255, 255, 255); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; opacity: 1; display: block; font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: middle;

path.style: visibility: visible; fill: rgb(207, 139, 23); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; opacity: 1; display: inline; font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; dominant-baseline: auto;
